en: Black‑and‑white landscape postcard showing a rural road leading toward a lakeside village with scattered wooden houses on the slopes of large forested mountains. A railroad and telegraph poles run along the water on the left, while fenced fields, haystacks, and trees line the road. In the distance are high rounded peaks with a few snow patches. Printed caption text appears at the bottom left, and a small oval publisher's mark appears at the lower right.
